channel.title: Smart Buyer Hub Knowledge Hub
channel.description: Australian property, mortgage and finance insights from Smart Buyer Hub, Sydney mortgage broker.

item.title: The Two-Speed Crash: Why Australia's Downturn Is Only Hitting Homes You Can't Afford
item.description: Australia's home values fell 0.7% in July, the worst month since 2022. But the falls are concentrated in premium property while cheaper homes keep rising.

item.title: The Relief Rebound: Why Australia's Inflation Win Expires on Sunday
item.description: Inflation eased to 3.8% in June - but electricity is up 22.4% because rebates ended, and the fuel excise cut dies Sunday. What it means before the RBA meets.

item.title: One in Three: How Australia's 5% Deposit Scheme Became a High-Income Perk
item.description: One in three 5% Deposit Scheme users now earn above the old income caps - yet total first home buyer lending barely moved. What that means if you are buying.

item.title: The 0.8% Club: Why Only 38 Suburbs in Australia Pay Their Own Way
item.description: Cotality data shows just 0.8% of Australian suburbs are cash flow positive for investors in 2026. Where they are, why the maths broke, and what changes from July 2027.

item.title: The Regret List: What First Home Buyers Wish They'd Known Before Signing
item.description: First home buyers' real regrets are rarely about the price paid - they're about the costs nobody budgeted for and the fears that turned out overblown.

item.title: The Postcode Lottery: Why First Home Buyers Pay $0 Stamp Duty in Canberra and a Real Bill Everywhere Else
item.description: Two stamp duty deadlines landed one day apart in opposite directions. A state-by-state guide to what first home buyers actually pay in 2026.

item.title: Brisbane Just Had Its Worst Auction Weekend Since the 2020 Lockdowns
item.description: Brisbane's auction clearance rate just fell to its lowest level since April 2020 - months before the monthly price indices will show it.
